channel: pq-cl/_threads/single layer XMSS and DVT support
searchText: One thing that was brought up by <@1481393192950567003> , was the possibility to have a performance increase by moving back to the simpler single layer XMSS tree. The issue is that it would make DVT a lot harder <@1481393192950567003> what did you say the perf difference was? and what do clients think about this? So either we 1) pre-propagate + pre-aggregate the top layer (a bit of difficulty, but maybe doable?) -> everything (signature size and xmss aggregation time) gets 2x better. or 2) we go back to a single XMSS layer (bad for DVT with DKG): 2a) if we want small signature (1200 bytes): **33% faster xmss aggregation** 2b) if we are fine to be above 1200 bytes (as it's today), then roughly **50% faster xmss aggregation** just as an additional data point: we recently surveyed some of the larger staking operators on how they use split keys / distributed validator setups. The aggregated findings are here: https://hackmd.io/@Ladislaus/Sk-r_wdAfe btw, couldn't we have different layer xmss trees both compatible with the beaconchain? e.g if you runnign dvt you run xyz leanvm version if you run vanilla staking you run xyy lean vm version or just each version could publish 2 binaries, one optimized for dvt one for non dvt we could. It would mean let validators specify either 1 or 2 sub-trees at registration. It would work. The first issue I see is that there is an incentive to always go with 2 (because much faster keygen), and it's the one that is the hardest to handle for Ethereum. So it means we would need some way to disincentives it (x% less reward, idk). And second issue: it adds a bit of complexity. But still, I think it may be a viable solution. can you define 'hardest to handle for ethereum? excerpts.author: t.wambsgans
excerpts.content:
So either we
1) pre-propagate + pre-aggregate the top layer (a bit of difficulty, but maybe doable?) -> everything (signature size and xmss aggregation time) gets 2x better.
or 2) we go back to a single XMSS layer (bad for DVT with DKG):
2a) if we want small signature (1200 bytes): **33% faster xmss aggregation**
2b) if we are fine to be above 1200 bytes (as it's today), then roughly **50% faster xmss aggregation**
